t_advice_summary_textbox.text: At the beginning of each round, choose a random color. After a couple of goes, you will find out that a particular color provides a higher value of mushrooms, stick to that color. Also note that this can change at any time. When it happens also switch your mindset on that.

vb_textbox.text: There are about 6 different colored gnomes in this task and only two different colored baskets. The 6 different colored gnomes are halved, 3 colors of the different gnomes identify with a particular color of the basket. For you to be successful in this task, try as much as you can to identify which color of the gnomes matches which color of the basket. When this is done, you now work with the colored baskets (which is only 2 colors). When a particular color of a basket's value collected for mushrooms start reducing you switch to the other color of the basket by select gnomes that matched the color of the basket.
